license_required.quote: no person shall engage or attempt to engage in the practice of medicine or osteopathy within this state, or open, maintain, or occupy an office or place of business within this state for engaging in practice, or in any manner announce or express a readiness to engage in practice within this state, unless the person holds a valid and effective license or permit issued by the board

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Medical Licensure

name.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Medical Licensure

type.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Medical Licensure

degree_required.value: Graduate of a medical or osteopathic school approved by the board
degree_required.quote: Has graduated from a prescribed course of instruction in a medical or osteopathic school or college situated in the United States or Canada and approved by the board

required.quote: Has satisfactorily completed a prescribed course of postgraduate training of a duration to be established by the board in an administrative regulation

duration.value: Duration to be established by the board by administrative regulation
duration.quote: Has satisfactorily completed a prescribed course of postgraduate training of a duration to be established by the board in an administrative regulation promulgated in accordance with KRS Chapter 13A

kind.quote: Has satisfactorily completed a prescribed course of postgraduate training of a duration to be established by the board

exams.name: Board-prescribed examination (USMLE or equivalent)
exams.notes: Board may also issue licenses by endorsement from National Board of Medical Examiners or equivalent
exams.quote: Has successfully completed an examination prescribed by the board

interval_years.quote: A license issued by the board shall expire on June 30 of even-numbered years unless sooner suspended or revoked

required.quote: the board may require licensees to submit to interrogation as to the nature and extent of their postgraduate medical education and to require licensees found to be deficient in their efforts to keep abreast of new methods and technology, to obtain additional instruction and training therein

value: pediatric abusive head trauma (1 hour, one-time for certain specialties)
topical_requirements.quote: demonstrate completion of a one (1) time course of at least one (1) hour of continuing medical education approved by the board and covering the recognition and prevention of pediatric abusive head trauma

available.quote: Issue regular licenses without further testing by endorsement from another state having qualifications and standards at least as high as those of this state or by endorsement from the National Board of Medical Examiners

requirements.value: Applicant must have been endorsed in writing by original licensing state as being in good standing and would have satisfied all requirements for regular licensure in Kentucky
requirements.quote: An applicant seeking regular licensure in the Commonwealth who was originally licensed in another state may obtain licensure in the Commonwealth without further testing and training if the applicant: (a) Has been endorsed in writing by the applicant's original licensing state as being licensed in good standing in that state; and (b) Would have satisfied all the requirements for regular licensure described in the preceding subsections had the applicant sought original licensure in this state.

regulatory_model.quote: no person shall engage or attempt to engage in the practice of medicine or osteopathy within this state ... unless the person holds a valid and effective license or permit issued by the board

credential_type.quote: "Regular license" means a license to practice medicine or osteopathy at any place in this state

is_mandatory.quote: no person shall engage or attempt to engage in the practice of medicine or osteopathy within this state ... unless the person holds a valid and effective license or permit issued by the board

title_protection.quote: Each violation of KRS 311.560 shall constitute a Class D felony.

scope_protection.quote: no person shall engage or attempt to engage in the practice of medicine or osteopathy within this state, or open, maintain, or occupy an office or place of business within this state for engaging in practice ... unless the person holds a valid and effective license or permit issued by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making or presenting false, fraudulent, or forged statements in connection with an application for a license or permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly made or presented, or caused to be made or presented, any false, fraudulent, or forged statement, writing, certificate, diploma, or other thing, in connection with an application for a license or permit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing, aiding, or abetting fraud, forgery, deception, collusion, or conspiracy in connection with an examination for a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practiced, or aided or abetted in the practice of fraud, forgery, deception, collusion, or conspiracy in connection with an examination for a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing, procuring, or aiding in the procurement of an unlawful abortion
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committed, procured, or aided in the procurement of an unlawful abortion, including a partial-birth abortion or an abortion in violation of KRS 311.731

disciplinary_grounds.description: Entering a guilty or nolo contendere plea, or being convicted of a crime as defined in KRS 335B.010
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Entered a guilty or nolo contendere plea, or been convicted, by any court within or without the Commonwealth of Kentucky of a crime as defined in KRS 335B.010, if in accordance with KRS Chapter 335B

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of sexual offense involving a patient or found to have had sexual contact with a patient while under care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been convicted of a misdemeanor offense under KRS Chapter 510 involving a patient, or a felony offense under KRS Chapter 510, 530.064(1)(a), or 531.310, or been found by the board to have had sexual contact as defined in KRS 510.010(7) with a patient while the patient was under the care of the physician

disciplinary_grounds.description: Becoming addicted to a controlled substance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Become addicted to a controlled substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Becoming a chronic or persistent alcoholic
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Become a chronic or persistent alcoholic

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being unable to practice medicine according to acceptable standards due to mental or physical illness or other condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been unable or is unable to practice medicine according to acceptable and prevailing standards of care by reason of mental or physical illness or other condition including but not limited to physical deterioration that adversely affects cognitive, motor, or perceptive skills, or by reason of an extended absence from the active practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct of a character likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public or any member thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making a false statement in any document executed in connection with the practice of the profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly made, or caused to be made, or aided or abetted in the making of, a false statement in any document executed in connection with the practice of his profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing or aiding an unlicensed person in the practice of medicine or osteopathy
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employed, as a practitioner of medicine or osteopathy in the practice of his profession in this state, any person not duly licensed or otherwise aided, assisted, or abetted the unlawful practice of medicine or osteopathy or any other healing art

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or attempting to violate any provision of any medical practice act or valid board regulation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated or attempted to violate, directly or indirectly, or assisted in or abetted the violation of, or conspired to violate any provision or term of any medical practice act, including but not limited to the code of conduct promulgated by the board under KRS 311.601 or any other valid regulation of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any agreed order, letter of agreement, final order, or emergency order issued by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated any agreed order, letter of agreement, final order, or emergency order issued by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in or attempting to engage in the practice of medicine under a false or assumed name, or impersonating another practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in or attempted to engage in the practice of medicine or osteopathy under a false or assumed name, or impersonated another practitioner of a like, similar, or different name

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a fee on the fraudulent representation that a manifestly incurable condition could be cured
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtained a fee or other thing of value on the fraudulent representation that a manifestly incurable condition could be cured

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully violating a confidential communication
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully violated a confidential communication

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license to practice medicine revoked, suspended, restricted, or limited in another state or foreign nation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Had his license to practice medicine or osteopathy in any other state, territory, or foreign nation revoked, suspended, restricted, or limited or has been subjected to other disciplinary action by the licensing authority thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Giving or receiving fees, commissions, or rebates for referring patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Given or received, directly or indirectly, from any person, firm, or corporation, any fee, commission, rebate, or other form of compensation for sending, referring, or otherwise inducing a person to communicate with a person licensed under KRS 311.530 to 311.620 in his professional capacity or for any professional services not actually and personally rendered

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being removed, suspended, expelled, or disciplined by any professional medical association for unprofessional conduct or incompetence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been removed, suspended, expelled, or disciplined by any professional medical association or society when the action was based upon what the association or society found to be unprofessional conduct, professional incompetence, malpractice, or a violation of any provision of KRS Chapter 311

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being disciplined by a licensed hospital or medical staff for unprofessional conduct, incompetence, or malpractice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been disciplined by a licensed hospital or medical staff of the hospital, including removal, suspension, limitation of hospital privileges, failing to renew privileges for cause, resignation of privileges under pressure or investigation, or other disciplinary action if the action was based upon what the hospital or medical staff found to be unprofessional conduct, professional incompetence, malpractice, or a violation of any provisions of KRS Chapter 311

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with requirements of KRS 213.101, 311.782, or 311.783 regarding reporting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to comply with the requirements of KRS 213.101, 311.782, or 311.783 or failed to submit to the Vital Statistics Branch in accordance with a court order a complete report as described in KRS 213.101

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with requirements regarding making or maintaining medical records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to comply with any of the requirements regarding making or maintaining medical records or documents described in KRS 311.7704 or 311.7707

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of female genital mutilation, resulting in mandatory license revocation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been convicted of female genital mutilation under KRS 508.125, which shall result in mandatory revocation of a license

definition_quote.value: the 'practice of medicine or osteopathy' means the diagnosis, treatment, or correction of any and all human conditions, ailments, diseases, injuries, or infirmities by any and all means, methods, devices, or instrumentalities
definition_quote.quote: the "practice of medicine or osteopathy" means the diagnosis, treatment, or correction of any and all human conditions, ailments, diseases, injuries, or infirmities by any and all means, methods, devices, or instrumentalities

methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis, treatment, or correction of any and all human conditions, ailments, diseases, injuries, or infirmities by any and all means, methods, devices, or instrumentalities

license_status_types.quote: "Regular license" means a license to practice medicine or osteopathy at any place in this state; "Limited license" means a license to practice medicine or osteopathy in a specific institution or locale to the extent indicated in the license; "Temporary permit" means a permit issued to a person who has applied for a regular license; "Emergency permit" means a permit issued to a physician currently licensed in another state; "Fellowship training license" means a license to practice medicine or osteopathy in a fellowship training program; "Special faculty license" means a license to practice medicine that is limited to the extent that this practice is incidental to a necessary part of the practitioner's academic appointment

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must be certified by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG) or by an approved United States specialty board, and must complete a prescribed course of postgraduate training
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: Has been certified by the educational commission for foreign medical graduates or by an approved United States specialty board

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Physician using telehealth must verify patient identity, establish documented diagnosis through accepted medical practices, and maintain current medical record; electronic/online/telephonic evaluation by questionnaire is inadequate for initial or follow-up evaluation
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: Verification that the person requesting medication is in fact who the patient claims to be; Establishment of a documented diagnosis through the use of accepted medical practices; and Maintenance of a current medical record. For the purposes of this paragraph, an electronic, on-line, or telephonic evaluation by questionnaire is inadequate for the initial evaluation of the patient or for any follow-up evaluation.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is hereby enacted and entered into with all other jurisdictions that legally join in the Compact

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: "Supervision" means overseeing the activities of and accepting of responsibility for the medical services rendered by a physician assistant. Each team of physicians and physician assistants shall ensure that the delegation of medical tasks is appropriate to the physician assistant's level of training and experience, that the identifications of and access to the supervising physician are clearly defined, and that a process for evaluation of the physician assistant's performance is established.

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: PA may prescribe and administer all nonscheduled legend drugs; with board approval, may prescribe Schedule III, IV, and V controlled substances to extent delegated by supervising physician; Schedule III limited to 30-day supply without refill; Schedule IV/V limited to original plus refills not exceeding 6-month supply
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: A physician assistant may prescribe and administer all nonscheduled legend drugs and medical devices to the extent delegated by the supervising physician. A physician assistant who has been approved by the board pursuant to paragraph (b) of this subsection, may prescribe and administer Schedules III, IV, and V controlled substances

max_physician_assistants_per_supervising.quote: A physician may enter into supervision agreements with no more than four (4) physician assistants and shall not supervise more than four (4) physician assistants at any one (1) time.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: any hospital or medical staff of said hospital located in the Commonwealth of Kentucky, shall report all actions taken against a licensed physician as described in KRS 311.595(20) and (21) to the board within thirty (30) days of the final adjudication of said action

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The board may establish by contract, including with a nonprofit corporation, or otherwise the Kentucky Physician Health Foundation to promote the early identification, intervention, treatment, and rehabilitation of individuals licensed by the board who may be impaired by reason of illness, alcohol or drug abuse, or as a result of any physical or mental condition.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: When a hearing or inquiry panel has probable cause to believe a physician is suffering from a physical or mental condition that might impede his ability to practice competently, the panel may order the physician to undergo a physical or mental examination by persons designated by the panel.

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: "Emergency permit" means a permit issued to a physician currently licensed in another state, authorizing the physician to practice in this state for the duration of a specific medical emergency, not to exceed thirty (30) days

sexual_misconduct_training_required.quote: The board shall develop specific guidelines to follow upon receipt of an allegation of sexual misconduct by a physician licensed by the board. The guidelines shall include investigation, inquiry, and hearing procedures which ensure that the process does not revictimize the alleged victim or cause harm if a physician is falsely accused.
